Letter.Body: The stall was my mother's. The clerk says the permit ended the day she died, 6 months ago. Ithad been in our family for 2 generations

Claims: The stall was in the family for 2 generations.

Letter.Intent: Wants to fix the north bridge
Letter.Body: The bridge on the north path has gone rotten in the middle. 3 carts have already turned back; and the crossing has been shut for 4 days.

Claims: This seal belongs to The Market.
Goro is the head of The Market
